say: Here's a site plan for a new metal building.

scenes.say: The new building sits in the corner of the lot, six feet off the east line and five feet off the south. A twenty-four foot gravel driveway runs out to Example Street.
A swale along the east side carries the roof water north. It holds the first inch of rain: two hundred four point seven cubic feet, against seventy-seven point three required.
Every number here comes from the sheet. Drawn by Your Company.
